about: Every finding of every target in targets.json, triaged by hand from the code and the upstream history. make lint must reproduce exactly these (rule, file, line). Verdicts: 'true positive' (the code does what the rule describes), 'true positive, fixed upstream' (gone at the fix named), 'true positive (hardening)' (real, not reachable today), 'the mutant' (the finding a mutant exists to produce). No finding is a false positive.

wallet-backend@main.message: closure walkInvocation recurses over SorobanAuthorizedInvocation with no depth or node budget
wallet-backend@main.why: walkInvocation walks the declared authorization tree with no depth or node bound; harmless at today's limits (245 levels apply), hardening. Fixed by linter/patches/wallet-backend-820.diff (bounds 256 and 4096, stops instead of failing)

wallet-backend@main.message: an address that may be muxed (M...) or not an account is passed to stageHistoryRow, where it reaches .WithAccount() at blend/processor.go:439; it comes from ScAddress.String at blend/scval.go:71
wallet-backend@main.why: Blend's addrString stringifies any ScAddress with no kind check and the result keys accounts. The same shape #756 fixed in the SEP-41 processor with types.StorableAddressString ('a real contract cannot emit them today'). Unreachable today: only pinned Blend WASM is decoded, and Blend takes Address arguments, which the host limits to G and C. Fixed by linter/patches/wallet-backend-blend-address.diff
